1. npmjs.com.issue: Cloudflare DDoS protection, ConnectionResetError, block of direct automated headless agents.
1. npmjs.com.solution: Use Playwright with extra-stealth (playwright-stealth) or a residential proxy. Or fetch registry endpoints directly (e.g., https://registry.npmjs.org/<package>) to extract metadata instead of scraping the web page.

2. sveltekit.dev.issue: Private IP block / DNS resolution failure or redirection to svelte.dev.
2. sveltekit.dev.solution: Follow redirect to https://svelte.dev/docs/kit or use DNS lookup over Google DNS/Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8) to bypass internal network address false-positives.
2. sveltekit.dev.code_example:
import dns.resolver
# Query public nameservers directly
resolver = dns.resolver.Resolver()
resolver.nameservers = ['1.1.1.1']

3. dynamodb.aws.amazon.com.issue: Internal AWS network security walls / direct scrape restriction or incorrect subdomains.
3. dynamodb.aws.amazon.com.solution: Scrape AWS documentation or use boto3/AWS CLI to fetch DynamoDB service specifications and region status instead of scraping the subdomain directly.
3. dynamodb.aws.amazon.com.code_example:
import boto3
client = boto3.client('dynamodb', region_name='us-east-1')
print(client.list_tables())

4. inertia.dev.issue: Redirects to inertiahs.com or Cloudflare blocks.
4. inertia.dev.solution: Map URL correctly to inertiajs.com, configure proper headers like User-Agent, Accept-Encoding, Accept-Language, or use a fetch tool supporting SSL Session Tickets (like curl_cffi).
4. inertia.dev.code_example:
from curl_cffi import requests
r = requests.get('https://inertiajs.com', impersonate='chrome110')

5. solid-js.com.issue: Redirect / SPA routing or false-positive internal address warning.
5. solid-js.com.solution: Navigate with a real headless browser or use a public external proxy (e.g. ScraperAPI, ZenRows) to resolve the DOM post-hydration.
5. solid-js.com.code_example:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()

    print(page.title())

9. mysql.com.solution: Handle cookie handshake programmatically by saving the session cookies first or simulating the browser session lifecycle.
9. mysql.com.code_example:

# Subsequent requests will use active session cookies

10. namecheap.com.solution: Introduce a small wait time (5s) for browser challenge verification or use high-quality residential proxies.

11. google.com/ai.solution: Target the actual redirect destination directly (https://ai.google/ or https://deepmind.google/) instead of the legacy route.

12. crates.io.issue: Requires API User-Agent specification under Rust/Cargo scraping policy.
12. crates.io.solution: Add custom descriptive User-Agent detailing your bot and contact email, or fetch via crates.io API directly.

13. gitlab.com/features/ci-cd.issue: Cloudflare browser checks and dynamic rendering blocks.
13. gitlab.com/features/ci-cd.solution: Access GitLab via GraphQL or REST API, or use a headless browser with custom screen resolution and viewport sizes.

14. stackoverflow.com.issue: Rate limits and Cloudflare challenge blocks.
14. stackoverflow.com.solution: Retrieve data via the Stack Exchange API (api.stackexchange.com) or SEDE (Stack Exchange Data Explorer).

15. medium.com.issue: Strict Paywall and Cloudflare IP block on cloud/hosting ranges.
15. medium.com.solution: Access archive snapshots on archive.org, parse AMP pages (append ?format=amp), or fetch RSS feed.

16. replit.com.issue: GraphQL backend, heavy frontend rendering, Cloudflare blocking.
16. replit.com.solution: Extract using a dedicated WebSocket or browser automation with intercepted API network requests.

17. codepen.io.issue: Dynamic iframe rendering and Cloudflare protection.
17. codepen.io.solution: Directly fetch the clean frame outputs by utilizing '/pen/' -> '/details/' or '/debug/' endpoint structures.

18. elasticco.com.issue: Typo in domain / Cloudflare connection resets.
18. elasticco.com.solution: Correct the domain name to https://www.elastic.co/ and handle cookies correctly.

19. azure.microsoft.com.solution: Utilize locale-neutral paths (e.g. /en-us/) and bypass client-side localization redirects.
